summary: Patch merges consecutive same-multiplicity factors in dup_sqf_list so that all factors sharing a multiplicity collapse into the single square-free component s_i (e.g. (x-2)(x-3) → x^2-5x+6, mult 3), matching the square-free factorization definition and the reported expected output. Reasonable, minimal fix for the univariate dense path; main open question is whether the multivariate/dmp path needs the same treatment for full consistency.

issues.description: Fix only touches dup_sqf_list (univariate dense). If dmp_sqf_list / multivariate path can exhibit the same split-multiplicity output, consistency issue may persist there. Reported case is univariate, so acceptable, but worth confirming.

Merge collapses same-multiplicity entries at the output stage rather than addressing why the inner loop emits multiple partial factors for one multiplicity. Symptom-level fix, but since square-free s_i is exactly the product of those coprime pieces, the result is mathematically correct.
No inline comment explaining why same-multiplicity results are multiplied together; a one-line note would aid future maintainers.
